newsitem.title: USA: Plum Street forms photovoltaic venture.
newsitem.headline: Plum Street forms photovoltaic venture.

text.p: Plum Street Enterprises Inc's Global Energy Group said it has formed Direct Global Power Inc, a venture with Direct Gain LLC of Cottekill, N.Y.

Through domestic and international partnerships, Direct Global Power will use creative economic and technological approaches to market photovoltaic products, Plum Street said. It is a Niagara Mohawk Power Corp subsidiary.

Direct Global Power initially will focus on developing economies, where the lack of an existing electrical infrastructure makes PV an attractive alternative to the massive investment required to build traditional generation, transmission and distribution facilities. Photovoltaic cells convert sunlight directly into electricity.
Richard Lewandowski will serve as chief executive of the new venture. He is the former president of Direct Gain, a New York photovoltaics consulting firm.

Direct Global Power will absorb all of Direct Gain's PV related contracts and projects. Direct Global Power has been in development (through Direct Gain) for almost twenty months and has dozens of agreements with various strategic partners and clients around the world, Plum Street said.
